title: 第一卷 第21章 青莲剑第一卷 第22章 玄尘道人出手
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
顾天阳的战斗力得到了质的变化。
他还缺少一把趁手的武器。
“系统，搜索王级极品长剑！”
【王级极品——赤焰剑：】
消耗1800族运点，剑身蕴含火焰之力，攻击带有灼烧效果。
【王级极品——寒冰剑：】
消耗1900族运点，剑身蕴含寒冰之力，攻击带有冰封效果。
【王级极品——青莲剑：】
消耗2000族运点，剑身由万年青莲玉髓炼制而成，蕴含生生不息的青莲之力。
与《青莲剑决》完美契合，可增幅剑招威力。
【……】
顾天阳的目光直接落在了《青莲剑》上。
这部剑与他刚刚兑换的《青莲剑决》完美契合，能够极大地增幅剑招的威力，简直是为他量身定做的。
“兑换青莲剑！”
【叮！
族运点扣除2000！
【青莲剑已发放至系统空间，宿主可随时取出使用！
顾天阳心念一动，一把长剑出现在他的手中。
长剑剑身光洁如玉，散发着淡淡的青芒，剑身上雕刻着栩栩如生的青莲图案。
他握住剑柄，一股温润的气息从剑身传来，与他体内的灵力瞬间产生共鸣。

他感觉到自己与青莲剑之间建立起了一种奇妙的联系。
仿佛这把剑已经陪伴了他无数年。
“哈哈！”
顾天阳忍不住放声大笑，心中充满了畅快之感。
【姓名：顾天阳】
身份：顾家族长
年龄：18岁
修为：灵海境十层（极境）
体质：太阳神体
功法：《太阳帝经》
武技秘术：王级极品——《青莲剑决》、王级极品——《风云步》、王级极品——《截天指》
武器：极道帝兵——万物母气鼎、王级极品——青莲剑
灵晶储备：下品灵晶x999万、中品灵晶x100万、上品灵晶x100万、极品灵晶x1万
族运点：可用2400点（综合：25500）
看着面板上的数据，顾天阳脸上露出了满意的笑容。
他现在的实力，足以横扫天源府内的所有势力。
顾天阳收起青莲剑后，起身准备离开石室。
他的神识瞬间笼罩了整个顾家。
正好看到王嫣然领着两个人到了顾家的议事大厅。
顾天阳的身影，如同鬼魅般出现在大厅的附近，嘴角噙着一丝若有若无的笑意。

此刻大厅内的气氛已然剑拔弩张。
content_en:
Gu Tianyang's combat effectiveness has undergone a qualitative change.
He also lacked a handy weapon.
"System, search for the best king-level long sword!"
[The best king-level product—Red Flame Sword:]
It consumes 1800 clan luck points, the sword body contains the power of fire, and the attack has a burning effect.
[The best king-level product - Ice Sword:]
It consumes 1900 clan luck points, the sword body contains the power of ice, and the attack has a freezing effect.
[The best king-level product - Green Lotus Sword:]
Consuming 2,000 clan luck points, the sword body is made of Evergreen Lotus Chalcedony, which contains the endless power of the Green Lotus.
Perfectly matched with "Qinglian Sword Jue", it can increase the power of sword moves.
【……】
Gu Tianyang's eyes fell directly on the "Green Lotus Sword".
This sword perfectly matches the "Qinglian Sword Jue" he just redeemed. It can greatly increase the power of sword moves. It is simply tailor-made for him.
"Exchange for the Green Lotus Sword!"
[Ding!
2,000 points will be deducted from family fortune points!
[The Green Lotus Sword has been distributed to the system space, and the host can take it out and use it at any time!
Gu Tianyang thought, and a long sword appeared in his hand.
The blade of the long sword is as clean as jade, exuding a faint green light, and the sword is engraved with a lifelike green lotus pattern.
He held the hilt of the sword, and a warm breath came from the sword body, instantly resonating with the spiritual power in his body.
He felt that he had established a wonderful connection with Qinglian Sword.
It was as if this sword had been with him for countless years.
"Haha!"
Gu Tianyang couldn't help laughing loudly, and his heart was filled with a sense of joy.
[Name: Gu Tianyang]
Identity: Head of the Gu family
Age: 18 years old
Cultivation: Tenth level of the spiritual sea realm (extreme realm)
Physique: Sun God Body
Kung Fu: "Sun Emperor Sutra"
Martial arts secrets: The best at the king level - "Green Lotus Sword Jue", the best at the king level - "Feng Yun Step", the best at the king level - "Jie Tian Zhi"
Weapons: The Supreme Emperor's Weapon - the Mother Qi Cauldron of All Things, the best king-level weapon - the Green Lotus Sword
Spiritual crystal reserve: low-grade spiritual crystal x9.99 million, medium-grade spiritual crystal x1 million, high-grade spiritual crystal x1 million, top-grade spiritual crystal x10,000
Family Luck Points: 2,400 points available (overall: 25,500)
Looking at the data on the panel, Gu Tianyang showed a satisfied smile on his face.
His current strength is enough to sweep all the forces in Tianyuan Mansion.
After Gu Tianyang put away the Qinglian Sword, he stood up and prepared to leave the stone room.
His consciousness instantly enveloped the entire Gu family.
I happened to see Wang Yanran leading two people to the Gu family's meeting hall.
Gu Tianyang's figure appeared near the hall like a ghost, with a faint smile on his lips.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the hall was already tense.
